summary: The diff implements most of the requested performance optimization requirements. REQ-2, REQ-3, REQ-5, REQ-6, and REQ-7 are substantially implemented. REQ-4 (critical CSS inlining and defer/async scripts) is partially implemented — the critical CSS inline style tag is present in index.html, but there is no evidence of non-essential script tags having defer/async attributes added in index.html (the file is truncated). REQ-7 is partially addressed in index.css with a font-display: swap @font-face declaration, but there is no evidence of a Google Fonts URL with &display=swap in index.html. ProductGrid.tsx and ProductManagement.tsx are not shown in the diff, so explicit width/height audit for those components (REQ-5) cannot be fully confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Non-essential script tags in index.html must have defer or async attributes; no render-blocking scripts before closing body tag without defer/async
missing_requirements.reason: The index.html diff is truncated and only shows the head section with critical CSS inlined. There is no visible evidence that non-essential script tags were given defer/async attributes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Any Google Fonts URL in index.html must include the &display=swap parameter
missing_requirements.reason: No Google Fonts link tag is visible in the index.html diff and no evidence of &display=swap being added to a Google Fonts URL. The index.css adds a font-display: swap @font-face rule but this covers only a local fallback font.

missing_requirements.requirement: All img tags in ProductGrid.tsx and ProductManagement.tsx must have explicit width and height attributes
missing_requirements.reason: ProductGrid.tsx and ProductManagement.tsx are not included in the modified files list of the diff. The audit for explicit width/height on those components cannot be confirmed from the available diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: HTML entry point is minified in the build output
missing_requirements.reason: The vite.config.ts sets terser and lightningcss minification for JS and CSS, but there is no vite-plugin-html or equivalent configuration to minify the HTML entry point. No HTML minification plugin is added.

hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked for terser minification settings and CSS minification. The manual chunk splitting strategy was not requested in any requirement.
